blocks.text: Module test B1.2 · Syntax
Instructions

Week 123 of the calendar, after verification B1-08 → B1-14. Duration: approx. 100 minutes for parts A/E, plus 10 minutes of interview with the tutor. Work without notes; the dictionary by root is allowed only in part D (translation). Fix it with the solution. Part B script is at the beginning of solutions: let another person read it or paste it into a voice synthesis app without reading it. The text of Part A is without vowels.

Overcoming. At least 38 points above 50At least 2 in each criterion of headings (Parts E and F) and at least 3 on 4 of Accuracy in translation (Part D: at least 6 points). If you do not pass the test, review the weaker unit at the beginning of the week 124 and repeat the tutor test within the week 125, while working on ONO-03.
A · Reading (8 points)
⁧معرض الكتاب يستقبل زواره في دورته العشرين⁩
⁧افتتح وزير الثقافة مساء أمس الدورة العشرين لمعرض الكتاب الدولي، بمشاركة ثلاثمئة وخمسين دار نشر⁩
⁧من اثنتين وعشرين دولة. ودخل الزوار القاعات مسرعين منذ الساعات الأولى، ولم يمنعهم المطر الغزير من⁩
⁧الوقوف في طوابير طويلة.⁩
⁧ويضم المعرض هذا العام أكثر من مئة ألف عنوان، وتنخفض أسعار الكتب فيه انخفاضا ملحوظا، إذ تقدم⁩
⁧أغلب الدور خصما بنسبة عشرين بالمئة، ما عدا دور النشر الأجنبية.⁩
⁧ولولا ضيق المكان لاستقبلنا ضعف⁩ » ⁧وقال مدير المعرض إن عدد الزوار ازداد ارتفاعا في السنوات الأخيرة،⁩
⁧وأضاف أن المعرض لن يغلق أبوابه إلا في منتصف الليل طوال أيام الأسبوع الأول.⁩ .« ⁧هذا العدد⁩
⁧ومن أبرز ضيوف هذه الدورة كتاب وشعراء من فلسطين والعراق والجزائر، يلتقون بالقراء في ندوات⁩
⁧يومية. وإذا أراد الزائر أن يحضر إحدى هذه الندوات، فعليه أن يسجل مسبقا على موقع المعرض.⁩

Help: ⁧دَارُ نَشْرٍ⁩ "Publisher," pl. ⁧دُورُ نَشْرٍ⁩ · ⁧عُنْوَان⁩ here: title (of book) · ⁧خَصْم⁩ Discount: ⁧ضِيق⁩ • Shortness • ⁧أَبْرَز⁩ Most likely to be present ⁧القُرَّاء⁩ Readers ⁧نَدَوَات⁩ • meetings, debates. Reply in English (2 points for complete response, 1 if partial).
1. Who inaugurated what, and when? How many publishing houses do they participate, and from how many countries?
2. How did the visitors get in? What didn't stop them?
3. How many titles are there? What happens to prices? Who doesn't get the discount?
4. What does the director say about the number of visitors and the time? Who are the main guests and what Do you have to do who wants to attend a meeting?
B · Listening (6 points)
Listen to the three news twice, with 30 Second pause. Answer in English; 2 points for news. Useful words: ⁧الحُجُوزَات⁩ Bookings are not included. ⁧مُتَطَوِّع⁩ • voluntary. • voluntary.
1. What is the first news about? What numbers do you give?
2. What happened in the second news, and under what conditions?
3. What is said in the third news? What would have happened if...?
C · Language (12 points)
One point for an answer. Write with your vowels.

rows: Agreement: put the verb to the perfect
Agreement: put the verb to the perfect
Order. Translate: "There is a letter for you on the table."
Ḥāl. Translate: "He came out without saying anything."
Absolute complement: complete with the adjective ⁧كَبِير⁩
Hypothesis. Translate: "If I were you, I would accept."
Exception. Translate with ⁧لَا⁩ … ⁧إِلَّا⁩ : I only speak Arabic.

blocks.text: D · Translation from Arabic to English (8 points)
Translate into a natural Italian. Dictionary admitted.

1. ⁧لَوْ وَصَلَتِ المُسَاعَدَاتُ فِي الوَقْتِ المُنَاسِبِ لَمَا تَفَاقَمَتِ الأَزْمَةُ.⁩ 2. ⁧اِنْخَفَضَتْ نِسْبَةُ البِطَالَةِ انْخِفَاضًا طَفِيفًا لِلشَّهْرِ الثَّالِثِ عَلَى التَّوَالِي.⁩ 3. ⁧خَرَجَ آلَافُ المُتَظَاهِرِينَ إِلَى الشَّوَارِعِ وَهُمْ يُطَالِبُونَ بِرَفْعِ الأُجُورِ.⁩ 4. ⁧لَمْ يَحْضُرِ الاِجْتِمَاعَ إِلَّا ثَلَاثَةُ وُزَرَاءَ مِنْ أَصْلِ اثْنَيْ عَشَرَ.⁩ 5. ⁧يُعَدُّ هٰذَا القَرَارُ أَكْثَرَ القَرَارَاتِ إِثَارَةً لِلْجَدَلِ هٰذَا العَامَ.⁩

⁧المُسَاعَدَات⁩ Aids ⁧تَفَاقَمَ⁩ • worsening • ⁧مِنْ أَصْلِ⁩ (a total of) ⁧إِثَارَةٌ لِلْجَدَلِ⁩ • the rise of controversy. Evaluation: one vote of Accuracy by 1 a 4 on all five sentences, multiplied by 2 (4 = complete and precise · 3 = an inaccurate detail · 2 = an error that changes a part of the sense · 1 = compromised sense).
E · Written production (8 points)

Write a short article (about 120 words) about an event invented with many numbers: a fair, a marathon, a festival, a vote. Required elements: nominal title · first verbal sentence · two ḥāl (one of a word, one state phrase) · a comparison with ⁧أَكْثَرُ⁩ / ⁧أَقَلُّ⁩ + tamyīz · an absolute complement with an adjective · a hypothetical phrase ( ⁧إِذَا⁩ or ⁧لَوْ⁩ ) · an exception or a restriction · three numbers written in letters with the right name · two diptotes to the genitive. Evaluation: Accuracy 1–4 + Organization and vocabulary 1–4. Each missing mandatory item removes 1 Point to Accuracy (minimum 1).
F · Oral production (8 points)
With the tutor, about 10 minutes.

1. Reading numbers and names. The tutor gives you a chronicle paragraph without vowels, with numbers in digits and names own: read it aloud with desinence (numbers, diptotes, ḥāl), then summarize it in English in three sentences.
2. If the tutor asks you three hypothetical questions ( ⁧لَوْ كُنْتَ⁩ … ⁧؟ مَاذَا تَفْعَلُ إِذَا⁩ … ⁧؟⁩ ): Reply with full sentences, using even a ḥāl and a comparison.

3. Egyptian (2–3 minutes). Tell the Egyptian tutor what you did last weekend (past, a negation), then arranges with him an exit for next Saturday (future, invitation, timetable) (EGY-04, EGY-05). Evaluation: Accuracy 1–4 + Fluidity and pronunciation 1–4. The task 3 is part of both criteria. Part F assesses the tutor; Without tutors, it remains unfinished.
